def place(api, customer_id, *items):
    return api.orders.handle_create({"customer_id": customer_id,
                                     "items": [{"sku": s, "quantity": q} for s, q in items]})


def test_packing_slip_lists_lines_in_item_order_with_catalogue_names(shop):
    oid = place(shop, "c1", ("PEN", 4), ("BOOK", 2)).body["order_id"]
    response = shop.fulfilment.handle_packing_slip(oid)
    assert response.status == 200
    assert response.body == {
        "order_id": oid,
        "customer_name": "Ada",
        "lines": [
            {"sku": "PEN", "name": "Pen", "quantity": 4},
            {"sku": "BOOK", "name": "Book", "quantity": 2},
        ],
    }


def test_packing_slip_names_the_customer_on_the_order(shop):
    oid = place(shop, "c2", ("LAMP", 1)).body["order_id"]
    body = shop.fulfilment.handle_packing_slip(oid).body
    assert body["customer_name"] == "Grace"
    assert body["lines"] == [{"sku": "LAMP", "name": "Lamp", "quantity": 1}]


def test_packing_slip_unknown_order_is_404(shop):
    response = shop.fulfilment.handle_packing_slip("ord-9999")
    assert response.status == 404
    assert response.body == {"error": "order not found"}

    oid = place(shop, "c1", ("BOOK", 1)).body["order_id"]
    shop.orders.handle_cancel(oid)
    response = shop.fulfilment.handle_packing_slip(oid)
    assert response.status == 409
    assert "cancelled" in response.body["error"]
